Its children are `table-column`s; its rows are a JS data window (`range` asks, `set-rows` answers), keyed by `set-ids`, or a Rust row model (LS2: `SceneMut::set_table_model`, sorted, filtered and tree rows expanded in Rust, no JS call per page). Keyboard navigation, type-ahead, keyed selection and cell editing (WG5a). Give it a size or let flex-grow size it.

clear-rows.doc: Drops the data window (every row draws empty until `set-rows`).

edit.doc: `edit(rowId, column)`: starts editing that cell (its column must be `editable`).

end-edit.doc: `end-edit(commit)`: ends the open edit; true commits (`commit`), false reverts.

fit-columns.doc: `fit-columns(column?)`: sizes that column (child index), or every resizable shown column, to its header and the cells in the data window (Qt `resizeColumnsToContents`); `column-resized` for each.

scroll-to-row.doc: `scroll-to-row(row)`: scrolls the row into view on the next frame.

set-ids.doc: `set-ids(ids, labels?)`: the id of every row by position (and the text type-ahead matches); the row count is then `ids.length`. Selection, cursor and edits follow ids across sorts and filters. null: ids are positions again.

set-rows.doc: `set-rows(first, rows)`: the data window, rows `first..first + rows.length`, each row a list of cell values (strings, numbers, booleans; null for empty). Replaces the previous window.

column-menu.doc: A right click on the header opens a menu that hides and shows the `hideable` columns (after `header-context`, unless prevented).

current.doc: The cursor row's id (keyboard focus inside the table), -1 for none.

current-column.doc: The cursor column (Left/Right move it; F2 and typing edit that cell).

header-state.doc: The header as JSON (Qt `saveState`): `{"widths":{name:points},"hidden":[name],"sort":{"column":name,"order":…}}`. The table writes it after the user resizes, hides or sorts; setting it restores them. Persist it with DX1's `uiState()` (`bind:header-state={ui.header}`): the table itself never writes files.

hidden-columns.doc: The hidden columns, by `name` (a column without one by its child index, `"2"`). The column menu changes it.

overscan.doc: Rows beyond the visible ones that `range` asks for on each side (data ready before it scrolls into view).

row-count.doc: Number of rows (the scroll extent). Rows without data yet are drawn empty.

row-height.doc: Height of every row (and of the header row), in points.

selected.doc: The selected row ids (`bind:selected`); clicks (Ctrl/Shift with `selection="multi"`) and the keyboard change it. Kept by id across `set-ids` (sorts, filters).

selection.doc: `single`, `multi` (Ctrl/Shift clicks and keys, ranges) or `none` (a cursor only).

sort-column.doc: The column (child index) the header shows sorted, -1 for none: then each column's own `sort` shows.

sortable.doc: A header click sorts on that column: `sort-column` becomes it, `sort-order` ascending, or flips when it already was (the rows are still sorted by JS, on `sort-changed`).

sticky-columns.doc: Number of leading columns that do not scroll horizontally.

stretch-last.doc: The last shown column fills the width the columns leave (Qt `stretchLastSection`).

striped.doc: Alternate rows get a faint background.

activated.doc: A row was double-clicked (a cell of a column that is not `editable`) or Enter pressed on the cursor row; carries its position.
activated.name: activated

changed.doc: The user changed the selection; carries the selected row ids (`bind:selected`).

column-resized.doc: The user resized a column (drag released, a double-click fit, `fit-columns`); carries the column and its width. The column's `width` is bindable.
column-resized.name: column-resized

columns-changed.doc: The column menu hid or showed a column; carries the hidden columns.
columns-changed.name: columns-changed

commit.doc: An edit is committed: row id, column index, the editor's value. Accept by returning nothing; reject with `e.result = 'reason'` (shown under the cell) or `e.preventDefault()`: the cell reverts.
commit.name: commit

copy.doc: Ctrl+C (Cmd+C) on the focused table; carries the selected row ids (the app copies the data it holds).

header-clicked.doc: A column header was clicked (sort on it in JS and set the column's `sort`).
header-clicked.name: header-clicked

header-context.doc: A right click on the header (Menu key on the focused table); carries the column under the pointer. Unless prevented, `column-menu` opens.

header-double-clicked.doc: A column header was double-clicked (not its resize edge); carries the column (child index).

header-state-changed.doc: The user resized, hid or sorted; carries the new `header-state` (save it).

radio.doc: One of a segmented group: a click checks it and never unchecks it (`Ui::selectable_value`); AccessKit role `RadioButton`. The app unchecks the others.

TreeView.doc: A virtualized tree: JS keeps the tree and flattens its visible rows into the list; children load when a node expands.

splice.doc: `splice(pos, removed, ids)`: replaces `removed` rows at `pos` with `ids` (the visible rows, flattened).

current.doc: OW5a1b: the cursor's row id (`bind:current`), -1 for none. Setting it moves the cursor without selecting.

indent.doc: Points per level; the disclosure triangle sits in the last one.

a11y.note: Each element page says what its own node is. Containers that only lay out (`box`, `grid`, ...) have no node: `anchor` and `invalid` reach AccessKit only on elements that have one.

Widget.css_note: What a given element paints is on its page: themed controls take their look per interaction state, other elements get a box.
Widget.doc: Common properties of everything placed in a window: state, tooltip, accessibility and its taffy item style.

scroll-into-view.doc: `scroll-into-view(align?)`: scrolls the scroll areas around the node so it is visible on the next frame, innermost first; `align` is `nearest` (the default: the least scrolling, keeping the area's `scroll-margin`) or `center`. Qt's `ensureWidgetVisible`, the DOM's `scrollIntoView`.

accessible-name.doc: AccessKit name (`Response::accessible_name`); inputs default to their hint or text.

align-self.doc: Cross-axis alignment in the parent box, overriding its `align-items`.

anchor.doc: A name unique in its embedded root: the node's egui id derives from it (stable across runs, not only across reorders), it is the AccessKit author id, and `Embed::anchor_rect` finds it. Changing it drops the node's egui memory.

anchor-scope.doc: Set by the runtime on the top nodes of a keyed `{#each}` item: the item's key, and the keys of the keyed items around it (outermost first, separated by U+001F). An `anchor` inside it takes its egui id from these keys and the anchors of its anchored ancestors, so repeated anchors in a keyed list get one id per row; `key=` selectors match it. Not for apps to set.

autofocus.doc: Takes keyboard focus when it first appears (in a `dialog` scope: when the dialog opens).

bottom.doc: Inset from the containing block's bottom edge in points; null for auto.

dialog-role.doc: Its place in a `dialog-buttons` row (QDialogButtonBox roles): `accept`, `reject`, `destructive`, `apply`, `reset`, `help`, `action`; `auto` is `accept` for a `default` button, `reject` for a `cancel` one, else `action`. Also the `[dialog-role=…]` selector.

drag-data.doc: The drag payload's data (JSON for structured data); `drop` delivers it.

drag-type.doc: Makes the node a drag source: the payload's type, a MIME-like string (`cad/part`); empty for none.

drop-types.doc: Makes the node a drop target: the drag types it accepts, separated by spaces or commas (`*` any, `cad/*` a prefix); empty for none.

enabled.doc: Takes input when true; drawn greyed out otherwise (`Ui::add_enabled`).

flex-basis.doc: Main-axis size before growing or shrinking; null for auto.

flex-grow.doc: Share of the parent's free main-axis space.

flex-shrink.doc: Share of the parent's main-axis overflow to give up.

height.doc: Height in points; null for auto.

invalid.doc: Marks the value as invalid: an outline in the error colour (`Visuals::error_fg_color`) and AccessKit `invalid`. The app sets it; the widget never does.

left.doc: Inset from the containing block's left edge in points (`position: absolute` or `relative`); null for auto.

margin.doc: Outer spacing on all four sides, in points.

max-height.doc: Maximum height in points; null for none.

max-width.doc: Maximum width in points; null for none.

min-height.doc: Minimum height in points; null for auto.

min-width.doc: Minimum width in points; null for auto.

position.doc: `absolute` takes the node out of the flow and places it by `left`/`top`/`right`/`bottom` inside its containing block: the nearest `relative` or `absolute` ancestor, else the root.

right.doc: Inset from the containing block's right edge in points; null for auto.

source-loc.doc: Set by the runtime in dev builds: where the node was declared, as `file#offset` (the template element's byte offset in its `.svelte` file), then the component call sites it renders inside, innermost first, separated by U+001F. The visual designer and the inspector map a node to its source with it (`NodeRef::source_loc`, `source=` selectors). Not for apps to set.

status-section.doc: Its place in a `status-bar` (QStatusBar): `temporary` (after the start sections; hidden while a message or status tip shows), `start` (permanent, at the start), `end` (permanent, pushed to the end). Also the `[status-section=…]` selector.

status-tip.doc: Text for the status bar while the pointer is over the node (enabled or not; the innermost node with one wins) or, with nothing hovered, while it has keyboard focus: every `status-bar` of the viewport shows it in `::part(message)`, and `svelters_egui::status_tip` reads it. top.doc: Inset from the containing block's top edge in points; null for auto.

visible.doc: Shown and laid out when true (`display: none` otherwise).

width.doc: Width in points; null for auto.
